spellslinger.configuration.title: Malum: Spellslinger Configs
spellslinger.modifier.spirit_shredder: 10% Magic Vulnerability on hit for 15s or next Magic Damage (up to 10 times)
effect.spellslinger.spirit_shred.descrip: Increases Magic Damage taken by 10% per level.
spellslinger.curio.mystic_reverb_necklac: +Spirit Collection Echoes 50% of the Last Bullet Damage To Hit Targets As Magic Damage
spellslinger.gui.geas.pact_of_the_spells: Behold the world's end in thunderous gunfire
spellslinger.effect.geas.marskman: +Increases bullet damage the longer the bullet travels.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.soulshot_: Building on top of a certain artificer's work, I've been able to make a bullet modification, coating the rounds in Soulstained Steel, allowing them to impact the soul directly.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.bullet_wa: Utilizing Warp Flux's properties, and a bit of creative artificing, this belt slowly teleports ammunition I'm holding to load any guns I'm carrying. For safety reasons, it can't load guns I'm currently holding.
malum.gui.book.entry.void.bottomless_amm: Never let go of the trigger
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.bott:
At first, seems like a simple direct improvement to its predecessor, however, its mechanism still eludes me.
Using the spirit crystals I collect, it warps bullets into any firearms I'm currently carrying, held or not.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.myst: The Necklace of Mystic Reverb binds to any fired bullet, marking any hit targets. A fraction any bullet damage I dealt echoes directly into said target's soul whenever I collect a spirit crystal
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.void.modi: This modifier coats bullets in an unnatural flame, scorching the target's soul, weakening it to any direct attacks, increasing incoming magic damage. This has the unfortunate side-effect of making the bullets... awkward to hold.
spellslinger.gui.geas.pact_of_the_marksm:
Aim true and slay your foes with precision and poise.
-Increases gun damage the further the target is, starting at 20 blocks

Personal space is valuable.
-Decreases gun damage by half if the target is within 20 blocks
spellslinger.gui.geas.pact_of_the_spells:
Attune to your gun and let it speak for you.
- Gun modifiers have a chance to be applied twice

Live by and for the gun.
-Halved melee damage
-Halved staff charge recovery rate
